news.headline: Herbert is set to be the No. 3 tight end behind Oronde Gadsden and Hayden Rucci in Sunday's contest due to the absences
news.detail: Herbert is set to be the No. 3 tight end behind Oronde Gadsden and Hayden Rucci in Sunday's contest due to the absences of Charlie Kolar (forearm) and David Njoku (lower leg).
